title: Weapons and Tactics Instructor-Aviation Ground Support (II/III) (LtCol to 1stLt) and (CWO5 to WO) NMOS (0402, 1302, 7002), DC AVN
raw_text:
2. MOS 7077, Weapons and Tactics Instructor-Aviation Ground Support (II/III)
(LtCol to 1stLt) and (CWO5 to WO) NMOS (0402, 1302, 7002), DC AVN

    a. Summary. Aviation Ground Support-Weapons and Tactics Instructors
function as advisors to the commander and coordinate all Marine Air/Ground
Task Force (MAGTF) Aviation Ground Support (AGS) requirements. Operating
forces billet assignments for this NMOS include Marine aircraft wing, marine
wing support group, marine wing support squadron, and marine wing support
detachment. Non-operating forces billet assignments for this NMOS include
HQMC AXE-10, Marine aviation and weapons tactics squadron one, Marine Corps
air station, and tactical training exercise control group. The AGS WTI’s
educational requirements include planning and executing of airfield and air
base construction/repair and services, airfield security operations, airfield
damage repair, base recovery after attack, forward arming and refueling point
operations, and aircraft salvage/recovery. Additionally, both officers and
staff noncommissioned officers with this NMOS can be used to plan, train, and
assess AGS for the Marine aircraft wing.

       b.   Prerequisites

            (1) MOSs 1310, 1390, or 7002 must be a CWO.

            (2) MOSs 0402 or 1302 must be LtCol to 1stLt.

            (3) Must hold MOS 0402, 1302, 1310, 1390, or 7002.

            (4) Must have 12 months operating force experience.

            (5) Must be or have served in a MAW, MAG, MWSS, or MWSD.

            (6) Security requirement:     secret security clearance eligibility.

    c. Requirements. Must successfully complete the MAWTS-1 Weapons and
Tactics Instructor Course (M149731) Yuma, AZ.

       d.   Duties

            (1) Manages a unit's weapons and tactics training program.

            (2) Plans and executes the Unit Readiness Program.

            (3) Analyzes performance and provides corrective guidance.

        (4) Instructs on current enemy capabilities and tactics to counter
their threat.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Teachers and Instructors, All Other 25-3099.

       f.   Related Military Skill.     None.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
